what_it_enforces: Nothing opens on the operator's screen or in Docker
No headless Chrome or Playwright on the operator's machine, except as a documented fallback or for video rendering
The hidden test set's key is read only by its runner
No remote database migration applied without listing applied migrations in the same turn
No film or 3D render without consulting the shared asset library first
No prospecting message queued without the prospecting doctrine read in the conversation
Read-only sub-agents (collector, verifier) write nothing
Resuming a client file: the client summary command runs before any broad reading
Warn about a message sent at an inappropriate hour
Warn about a message whose thread has not been reread
Warn about an SMS reply sent without opening the attachments received
A factual question to the operator first goes through the unified search
No artifact the operator did not ask for
A list of questions for a third party written in a file states what was cross-checked
A message shown for approval comes after the thread checker has reread the thread
An absence is not concluded: the answer says where it searched and where the thing should be
An email draft is written after the client summary was read
An answer does not end with a factual question without the unified search
Refuse an answer that attributes to the operator words the operator never wrote
An email draft is written after checking whether the client was already answered
A step in a third-party app is handed to the operator only after trying every path the agent has
A deployment is checked after it ships
After its work session is closed, a conversation does not keep working without opening a new one
A list of what remains to be answered is re-read from the reply queue in the same turn
No visual piece shown on the review screen without its references and the published pieces opened side by side
An answer does not end with a list of questions for a third party without what was cross-checked
A page shown to the operator has passed the contrast check
A page shown to the operator has passed the width and empty-space check
A conversation that does work opens its work session
A file written into a client folder is filed in the document store
After a context summary, the work session is re-declared before working
"Everywhere", "all occurrences", "none left" is counted before it is said
An operator correction is recorded in the turn it is made
A task about a blocked channel closes only with a send proven through that channel
An opened project has its tasks in the planner
"Not sent", "not received", "blocked" is said after reading the direct source, not a lagging summary
A closed session has updated every task it names
Write to the CRM after every send
A numeric fact in the activity log is also written where it belongs
Read the log and the task before starting a task
No deployment of a working tree modified by another session
No new background agent installed before the operator's decision is reread
An answer that opens on an absence (not found, none, does not exist) has run the unified search on its subject
A chat answer is not written in tool jargon (ids, file names, code terms)
After a visual block is rejected, no variants of the same template: numbered choices or a framing question
No process killed by pattern: pkill and killall refused, kill on a verified PID only
